messages:
maria: kicking off quiet-window toggle plan for ff: llm_route_v4. goal is minimal noise during midnight batch jobs. deploy-bot: I will schedule toggles at 2025-11-01T23:00Z -> 00:30Z -> 02:00Z, cohorts [alpha,beta,gamma].
cheng: ack. what's the ramp schedule? short and conservative pls.
kevin: propose 0% -> 3% -> 15% -> 45% over ~3h with 20m checkpoints. watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and misroute_count.
maria: exactly. if p95 increases >25% or misroute_count > 0.3% for two consecutive checks, we rollback to v3 and pin routing for affected cohort(s).
sam: added release notes link to the rollout config: https://internal.releases/redwood/notes/llm-route-v4
deploy-bot: dry-run completed at 2025-11-01T22:35Z. sample command used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags/llm_route_v4/toggle \\n  -d '{"cohort":"alpha","percent":3}' \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN\"
```
kevin: good. telemetry alert thresholds are set in ops playbook. paste: ALERT: service.llm.p95 > baseline*1.25 for 2 windows -> notify #eng-oncall and pause rollout.
ops-bot: created incident stub INC-20251101-llmroute (auto) and assigned to cheng.
cheng: I'll be on-call at window. If we hit threshold, I'll pause and escalate for rollback.
maria: pinning plan: if rollback happens, set model_route pinned=v3.0.9 and cancel further cohorts. deploy-bot can auto-pin on rollback if enabled.
deploy-bot: auto-pin on rollback = enabled. will post confirmation when executed.
kevin: one more: keep quiet cohort traffic slice on (no sticky session changes) to avoid cache churn.
sam: added a short blurb to release notes: \"Canary rollout across quiet cohorts with conservative thresholds. Rollback triggers defined; contact cheng for oncall.\" :memo:
maria: thanks. will start first cohort at 23:00Z. I'll ping here when each checkpoint passes. :eyes:
